filter_recent_runtime_hours_per_day.name: Filter recent runtime hours per day

user.title: Connect Beestat
user.description: Bring Beestat history, schedules, alerts, and thermostat metadata into Home Assistant. Matching HomeKit devices are linked automatically; thermostat control stays with the integration that provides it. Filter estimates are calculated in Home Assistant from Beestat runtime and your configured policy.

data_description.api_key: Your Beestat API key. Home Assistant saves it in this integration entry and sends it to the configured API endpoint.
data_description.api_base: HTTPS endpoint for the Beestat API. Use the default unless you intentionally use a compatible endpoint.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Beestat Statistics
reconfigure.description: Validate and save a different API key or HTTPS endpoint for this entry.

data_description.api_key: Enter the new API key. Leave this field blank to keep the saved key.
data_description.api_base: HTTPS API endpoint to use with the saved or replacement key.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Beestat Statistics
reauth_confirm.description: The saved API key was rejected. Enter a valid key to restore access to Beestat.

data_description.api_key: A valid Beestat API key is required; this field cannot be blank.
data_description.api_base: HTTPS API endpoint where Home Assistant will validate this key.

account_change_confirm.title: Confirm Beestat account change
account_change_confirm.description: This connection could not be matched to the saved account using its thermostat identity and may access a different Beestat account. Continuing replaces the connection and clears source selections and per-source overrides, including mappings, filter settings, and saved filter changes. Sources absent from the new account stop updating. Imported Recorder history remains, and a new source with the same stable slug may continue an existing statistics series. Continue only if you intend this account and history change.

error.account_identity_unavailable: The connection succeeded, but Beestat returned no identifiable thermostats. Home Assistant cannot confirm which account it belongs to.
error.invalid_api_base: Use an HTTPS API URL with no embedded credentials, query string, or fragment.
error.mapping_source_unavailable: This entity has no usable entity-registry record. Choose a registered Home Assistant entity.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach Beestat. Check the API endpoint and try again.
error.unknown: The connection check failed unexpectedly. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.account_identity_unavailable: Setup stopped because Beestat returned no identifiable thermostats.
abort.configuration_changed: The saved configuration changed while this page was open. Start again to review the current values.
abort.yaml_connection_unavailable: The YAML connection could not be validated. Check its API key and HTTPS endpoint.
abort.yaml_connection_change_requires_reconfig: The YAML connection could not be matched to the saved account. Use Reconfigure to validate and confirm it, then update YAML to match the saved connection.

beestat_auth_failed.message: The saved API key was rejected. Reauthenticate Beestat Statistics to restore access.

beestat_request_failed.message: The request to Beestat failed. Check the integration status sensor for details.

invalid_api_base.message: The API URL is invalid or insecure. Use Reconfigure to enter an HTTPS endpoint without embedded credentials, a query string, or a fragment.

filter_change_boundary_date_mismatch.message: Repair requires a saved Home Assistant filter-date override whose local date matches the timestamp.

filter_change_boundary_local_time_invali.message: This local time is ambiguous or does not exist because of a clock change. Supply the timestamp with an explicit UTC offset.

filter_change_boundary_out_of_range.message: Use a filter-change timestamp no more than 31 days old and not in the future.

no_loaded_entry.message: Load a Beestat Statistics integration entry before running this action.

invalid_rebuild_date_range.message: The start date cannot be later than the end date.

unknown_thermostat_id.message: Thermostat {thermostat_id} is not configured in this Beestat Statistics entry.

statistics_import_failed.message: The Recorder import failed. Check the integration status sensor and Home Assistant log for details.

filter_change_boundary_conflict.message: The previous filter boundary or request token no longer matches. Review the current boundary before submitting a new replacement.

filter_change_not_after_prior.message: A new replacement must be later than the saved exact time, when present, and cannot predate the saved date. Use a date edit or boundary repair for corrections.

request_id_reused.message: This request ID belongs to another filter change. Give each new replacement its own request ID.

invalid_override_entity_domains.title: Beestat override entities use the wrong domain
invalid_override_entity_domains.description: These overrides reference entities of an unsupported type: {entities}. Choose entities in the required domains or remove the overrides, then reload Beestat Statistics.

mapping_device_conflicts.title: Beestat mappings select conflicting source devices
mapping_device_conflicts.description: There are {conflict_count} conflicting mappings. Entities in each mapping must represent the same physical device, and that device cannot serve more than one mapping of the same type. Correct or clear the mappings in the integration options. Device linking and temperature projections stay disabled for affected mappings until the conflicts are resolved.

missing_override_entities.title: Beestat override entities are missing
missing_override_entities.description: These overrides reference entities that no longer exist: {entities}. Replace or remove the references, then reload Beestat Statistics.

insecure_api_base.title: Beestat API URL is invalid or insecure
insecure_api_base.description: The configured endpoint failed URL validation, so Home Assistant did not contact it or send the API key. Use Reconfigure to enter an HTTPS URL without embedded credentials, a query string, or a fragment.

yaml_connection_change_requires_reconfig.title: Beestat YAML connection change needs confirmation
yaml_connection_change_requires_reconfig.description: The connection in YAML differs from the saved connection. Use Reconfigure to validate and confirm the intended account, then make YAML match it or remove the YAML block. The attempted YAML change did not alter mappings or imported history.

get_configuration.name: Get Beestat configuration
get_configuration.description: Read saved options, effective entity mappings, comfort profiles, and the allowed cached Ecobee settings. This action returns data without contacting Beestat or changing state.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: The loaded Beestat Statistics entry to inspect.

import_statistics.name: Import Beestat statistics
import_statistics.description: Refresh Beestat runtime and metadata, update the integration entities, and import daily statistics into Home Assistant Recorder.

point_lookback_days.name: Point lookback days
point_lookback_days.description: Recent local days of five-minute thermostat and room-sensor history to read, including setpoints and available air-quality data. Overrides the configured lookback for this import.

skip_sync.name: Skip Beestat sync
skip_sync.description: Skip the Beestat sync requests before reading and importing data. This does not make the import network-free.

rebuild_statistics.name: Rebuild Beestat statistics
rebuild_statistics.description: Recalculate Recorder statistics from the complete available Beestat summary history. Cumulative totals are rewritten from the start date through the latest source day; measurement series use the selected date range.

thermostat_id.name: Thermostat ID
thermostat_id.description: Rebuild one configured Beestat thermostat and its sensors. Omit to rebuild all configured sources.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First local date to write to Recorder. Earlier source history is still read to calculate cumulative totals.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last local date to write for measurement series. Cumulative totals continue through the latest source day so later values stay consistent.

skip_sync.name: Skip Beestat sync
skip_sync.description: Skip the Beestat sync requests before reading and rebuilding data. This does not make the rebuild network-free.

repair_filter_change_boundary.name: Repair filter change boundary
repair_filter_change_boundary.description: Refine the exact time of a filter change already saved in Home Assistant. Its local date must match the saved override date. Refreshes Beestat runtime after saving; incomplete history can leave reconciliation pending. This action does not acknowledge filter alerts or change Ecobee settings.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: The loaded Beestat Statistics entry containing this thermostat.

thermostat_id.name: Thermostat ID
thermostat_id.description: The configured Beestat thermostat with an existing Home Assistant filter-date override to refine.

changed_at.name: Changed at
changed_at.description: Verified time of the existing replacement, no more than 31 days old and not in the future. A value without an offset uses Home Assistant's timezone; ambiguous or nonexistent local times are rejected.

record_filter_change.name: Record filter change
record_filter_change.description: Save a physical replacement at its actual time, guarded by the previous boundary and request ID. Attempts to acknowledge matching filter alerts and refresh Beestat runtime. Handle the returned status before taking further action; runtime reconciliation may remain pending. Use a date edit or boundary repair for corrections.

config_entry_id.name: Configuration entry
config_entry_id.description: The loaded Beestat Statistics entry containing this thermostat.

thermostat_id.name: Thermostat ID
thermostat_id.description: The configured Beestat thermostat whose filter was replaced.

changed_at.name: Changed at
changed_at.description: For a new replacement, use its actual time within the last 31 days and not in the future. It cannot predate the saved date and must follow any saved exact time. Include a UTC offset to distinguish repeated local times.

expected_changed_at.name: Expected previous timestamp
expected_changed_at.description: The prior filter_changed_at value from the Filter changed date entity, or null if no exact time is saved.

expected_changed_date.name: Expected previous date
expected_changed_date.description: The prior home_assistant_override_date value from the Filter changed date entity, or null if no override date is saved.

expected_request_id.name: Expected previous request ID
expected_request_id.description: The prior filter_change_event.request_id captured for this replacement, or null if none exists. Keep that token when retrying; a later correction must not authorize an older request.

request_id.name: Request ID
request_id.description: An opaque ID of 1–128 characters for this replacement. An identical retry of the current saved request returns already_recorded without repeating effects, even after 31 days. Use a new ID for a new replacement.

init.title: Beestat Statistics options
init.description: Select Beestat sources, adjust import timing, review local entity mappings, and set the optional filter forecast policy for each thermostat.

timing.title: Import timing
timing.description: Set how often Home Assistant requests Beestat data and how much recent point history it includes in imports. A shorter interval does not make Beestat publish data sooner.

data_description.point_lookback_days: Recent local days of point history to read for daily Recorder statistics. The default is 45 days; a larger window increases import work.
data_description.scan_interval_seconds: Seconds between scheduled Beestat syncs and Recorder imports. The default is 21600 seconds (6 hours); the minimum is 300 seconds.

source_scope.title: Choose Beestat sources
source_scope.description: Choose the thermostats and room sensors to expose and import. Newly discovered active sources are included unless explicitly excluded. Excluding a source stops future updates and imports but keeps its existing Recorder statistics.

data_description.included_thermostat_ids: Thermostats whose entities and future statistics imports should be included.
data_description.included_sensor_ids: Room sensors whose entities and future statistics imports should be included.

source_scope_confirm.title: Confirm source exclusions
source_scope_confirm.description: You are excluding {thermostat_count} thermostat(s) and {sensor_count} room sensor(s). After reload, their entities stop updating and future imports omit them. Previously imported Recorder statistics remain.

confirm_automatic_mappings.title: Confirm automatic HomeKit mappings
confirm_automatic_mappings.description:
Review {thermostat_count} thermostat mapping(s) and {sensor_count} room-sensor mapping(s), covering {entity_count} local entities. Confirming saves these matches as explicit entity-registry references. If the matches change before saving, you must review the updated list. Missing, ambiguous, or conflicting matches are left unresolved.

{mapping_details}

thermostat_mapping.title: Map a Beestat thermostat
thermostat_mapping.description: Select a thermostat to review its Home Assistant entity mappings and optional filter forecast policy.

data_description.id: The Beestat thermostat whose mappings or filter settings you want to edit.

thermostat_mapping_detail.title: Thermostat HomeKit mapping
thermostat_mapping_detail.description: Selected thermostat: {item}. Clear an entity selection to remove its override and allow automatic matching. Filter limits are your maintenance policy; Home Assistant calculates estimates from that policy and Beestat runtime. Defaults are starting values, not manufacturer replacement recommendations.

data_description.climate_entity_id: The existing HomeKit climate entity for this physical thermostat. Leave blank for automatic matching.
data_description.temperature_entity_id: A temperature entity for this physical thermostat. Leave blank for automatic matching.
data_description.occupancy_entity_id: An occupancy binary sensor for this physical thermostat, if available. Leave blank for automatic matching.
data_description.motion_entity_id: A motion binary sensor for this physical thermostat, if available. Leave blank for automatic matching.
data_description.filter_changed_entity_id: Optional input_datetime helper for the replacement date. New setups can use the integration's Filter changed date entity. Clearing this override still allows automatic helper discovery.
data_description.filter_lifetime_runtime_hours: Recorded fan-runtime hours used as the replacement limit. The default is 250 hours; choose a value appropriate to your filter policy. Missing runtime makes derived dates provisional.
data_description.filter_max_age_days: Maximum calendar age from the effective replacement date. The default is 90 days. This limit still applies when runtime history is incomplete.
data_description.filter_notice_days: Days before the calculated due date when Filter due soon turns on. The default is 7 days; 0 starts on the due date. This does not send a notification by itself.

sensor_mapping.title: Map a Beestat room sensor
sensor_mapping.description: Select a room sensor to review its local entity mappings and the measurements imported into Recorder.

data_description.id: The Beestat room sensor whose mappings or import settings you want to edit.

sensor_mapping_detail.title: Room sensor HomeKit mapping
sensor_mapping_detail.description: Selected room sensor: {item}. Choose the local entities and daily statistics for this sensor. Clear an entity selection to remove its override and allow automatic matching.

data_description.thermostat_id: Override which Beestat thermostat owns this room sensor. This selection takes precedence over the owner reported by Beestat.
data_description.temperature_entity_id: A temperature entity for this physical room sensor. Leave blank for automatic matching.
data_description.occupancy_entity_id: An occupancy binary sensor for this physical room sensor, if available. Leave blank for automatic matching.
data_description.motion_entity_id: A motion binary sensor for this physical room sensor, if available. Leave blank for automatic matching.
data_description.include_temperature: Create daily temperature statistics in Recorder from this sensor's Beestat history.
data_description.include_air_quality: Create daily air-quality statistics when this sensor has Beestat air-quality data.
data_description.include_co2: Create daily CO2 statistics when this sensor has Beestat CO2 data.
data_description.include_voc: Create daily TVOC statistics when this sensor has Beestat TVOC data.

error.mapping_device_conflict: Choose entities belonging to one physical device and do not reuse that device in another mapping of the same type. A thermostat probe from another integration must have a matching hardware serial.
error.mapping_source_unavailable: This entity has no usable entity-registry record. Choose a registered Home Assistant entity.
error.no_discovered_items: No thermostats or room sensors are available yet. Run Refresh runtime, then reopen these options.

abort.no_automatic_mappings: No unconfirmed automatic mappings are currently available. Existing explicit mappings were left unchanged.
